run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the longest subarray with equal 0s and 1s in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of the longest subarray algorithm
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a hash map and cumulative sum approach to find equal 0/1 subarrays
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the TOFILL placeholder f_filled with a working implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which treats 0s as -1 and tracks sum differences to find the longest balanced subarray
